title: Medical debt as a visible household and credit signal
discussion_signal: The post connects medical debt, credit reporting, renting, employment, treatment delay, and household budgets. Its OSINT framing treats regulatory and data visibility as an early-warning system, while also showing how a medical cost becomes a broader mobility and security constraint.
linked_research_question: How is medical-cost exposure translated into credit visibility, housing and employment access, and household financial stress?
limits: The post combines multiple sources and interpretations
Some figures and legal claims require independent verification
Credit visibility is not the same as total medical debt or clinical harm
